summary_en: This Phase 1/2 study tests Mocertatug Rezetecan (Mo-Rez) combined with other anti-cancer medicines in advanced solid tumors, including gynecological cancers. Mo-Rez, dostarlimab, and bevacizumab are given by intravenous (IV) infusion, and how often and for how long is not stated. The record does not state a primary outcome, but the study looks at safety, tolerability, how the body handles the drug, and how well it works.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1/2 evalúa Mocertatug Rezetecan (Mo-Rez) combinado con otros medicamentos contra el cáncer en tumores sólidos avanzados, incluidos cánceres ginecológicos. Mo-Rez, dostarlimab y bevacizumab se administran por infusión intravenosa (IV), y no se indica con qué frecuencia ni durante cuánto tiempo. El registro no indica un resultado principal, pero el estudio analiza la seguridad, la tolerabilidad, cómo el cuerpo maneja el medicamento y qué tan bien funciona.
who_for: Adults 18 or older who can give signed informed consent.
Advanced solid tumor confirmed by pathology, with no more than 4 prior lines of systemic therapy.
At least one measurable target lesion per RECIST 1.1.
Life expectancy of at least 12 weeks, per investigator assessment.
Endometrial, ovarian, fallopian tube, or peritoneal cancer after failed or intolerant standard treatment (module-specific criteria).
not_for: Prior B7H4-targeted therapy or prior topoisomerase-1 inhibitor therapy.
Untreated brain or CNS metastases, or rapidly progressing brain or CNS metastases.
Current or past interstitial lung disease or non-infectious pneumonitis.
